projects.demo_story: Six duplicate alerts collapse into one, while a medication reminder bypasses focus mode with an explanation.
projects.test_strategy: Trace replay; deadline properties; dedupe precision; policy table tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic event stream and local OS exports.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Critical categories require conservative defaults, overrides, and a complete missed-event log.

projects.name: Offline Caption Quality Lab
projects.one_sentence: A local caption evaluator that measures timing, speaker identity, semantic errors, and readability against media constraints.
projects.concrete_problem: Word error rate alone misses unusable timing, speaker confusion, and meaning-changing mistakes.
projects.why_now: Automatic captions are widespread but quality control remains shallow.
projects.differentiator: It aligns multiple caption tracks and produces actionable error classes with playback-linked evidence.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compare two bundled caption tracks to a reference and surface a meaning reversal plus overlapping unreadable cues.
projects.demo_story: A track with better word error rate loses because one negation error reverses safety instructions.
projects.test_strategy: Hand-labeled fixtures; alignment perturbations; metric sensitivity; accessibility review checklist.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Open/bundled media and local caption files; no transcription API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Automated semantic flags need human review, especially for names and dialects.

projects.name: Portable Document Lake
projects.one_sentence: A content-addressed local document store with typed extraction, lineage, snapshot queries, and reversible reprocessing.
projects.concrete_problem: Research folders lose which parser, source, and transformation produced each extracted field.
projects.why_now: Local multimodal analysis needs durable lineage more than another file browser.
projects.differentiator: Raw bytes are immutable while derived schemas can be replayed and compared across parser versions.
projects.local_first_mvp: Ingest mixed bundled files, upgrade one extractor, and query differences between two reproducible catalog snapshots.
projects.demo_story: A changed date field is traced to a parser upgrade, not a modified source document.
projects.test_strategy: Round-trip fixtures; extractor version goldens; lineage properties; crash-safe ingestion.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local/open documents; extractors run offline.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Honor document licenses and encrypt sensitive collections.

projects.name: Privacy-Budget Telemetry
projects.one_sentence: A metrics SDK and local collector that accounts for cumulative privacy loss before exporting aggregate telemetry.
projects.concrete_problem: Adding noise per query does not prevent privacy loss from accumulating across repeated correlated releases.
projects.why_now: Teams want useful telemetry without building warehouses of raw user events.
projects.differentiator: A query planner rejects releases that exceed an explicit per-cohort epsilon ledger and shows the utility tradeoff.
projects.local_first_mvp: Collect synthetic app events, answer count and histogram queries, and deny a repeated query once its cohort privacy budget is exhausted.
projects.demo_story: A dashboard request appears harmless alone but is blocked after the ledger reveals cumulative exposure.
projects.test_strategy: Statistical distribution tests; accountant comparisons to known formulas; adversarial repeated-query cases; contribution-bound properties.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Only seeded synthetic events; no cloud telemetry backend.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Clearly documents that differential privacy guarantees depend on correct bounds, sampling, and threat assumptions.

projects.name: Research Data Lineage Packager
projects.one_sentence: A tool that packages datasets with transformation lineage, consent/license metadata, checksums, and executable validation.
projects.concrete_problem: Shared datasets lose how rows were filtered, whether fields may be redistributed, and which version underlies results.
projects.why_now: Data reuse is rising alongside stricter consent and provenance expectations.
projects.differentiator: Policy metadata propagates through transformations and can block incompatible exports.
projects.local_first_mvp: Transform two synthetic datasets, propagate conflicting licenses, and generate a verifiable allowed subset bundle.
projects.demo_story: A planned public export is blocked because one derived column retains a non-redistribution condition.
projects.test_strategy: Lineage properties; policy decision tables; archive reproducibility; tamper tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic/open data; no repository account.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Tooling cannot replace consent/legal review; sensitive rows require minimization.

projects.name: Smoke Sensor Calibrator
projects.one_sentence: A local calibration engine that fuses low-cost particulate sensors with reference periods, humidity, drift, and spatial uncertainty.
projects.concrete_problem: Cheap PM sensors provide useful coverage but biased readings can mislead health decisions.
projects.why_now: Wildfire smoke makes neighborhood-scale measurements increasingly valuable.
projects.differentiator: Corrections include uncertainty and drift detection rather than a universal linear formula.
projects.local_first_mvp: Calibrate a synthetic/open sensor month with seeded drift and recover held-out reference values.
projects.demo_story: A sensor that looks alarming is corrected for humidity, while another is flagged for genuine drift.
projects.test_strategy: Held-out error; seeded drift; missingness stress; uncertainty coverage.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic CSV and optional open datasets; no live API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Not an official air-quality alert; communicate uncertainty and follow public-health guidance.

projects.name: Stormwater Capacity Model
projects.one_sentence: A local graph and raster model that estimates runoff routing, inlet overload, and intervention effects under design storms.
projects.concrete_problem: Residents and small municipalities lack transparent tools for screening where drainage fails.
projects.why_now: Heavier rainfall is exposing infrastructure designed for older climate assumptions.
projects.differentiator: Every flooded node traces back to terrain, imperviousness, rainfall, and pipe assumptions with uncertainty bands.
projects.local_first_mvp: Simulate a synthetic neighborhood storm and compare permeable surfaces plus enlarged inlets.
projects.demo_story: A downstream pipe, not the visibly flooded inlet, is identified as the binding constraint.
projects.test_strategy: Mass conservation; analytic catchments; grid-resolution sensitivity; deterministic storms.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic rasters and optional open GIS files.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Screening tool only, not stamped engineering or emergency flood prediction.

projects.name: Trace Structure Compressor
projects.one_sentence: A storage engine that compresses distributed traces by deduplicating recurring causal structure while retaining query accuracy.
projects.concrete_problem: Trace storage repeats nearly identical span trees and attributes at massive cost.
projects.why_now: Telemetry growth now competes directly with application storage budgets.
projects.differentiator: Compression operates on trace grammar and supports bounded-error aggregate queries without full decompression.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compress generated traces 10x and answer service-latency/error queries within declared error bounds.
projects.demo_story: A rare failure path remains individually inspectable while routine traces collapse into a grammar.
projects.test_strategy: Round-trip properties; query differential tests; compression benchmarks; corruption recovery.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated and open-format local traces.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Compression must not defeat deletion, access control, or sensitive-attribute redaction.

projects.name: Civic Meeting Claim Tracker
projects.one_sentence: An offline pipeline that links claims in meeting transcripts to agenda items, votes, documents, and later corrections.
projects.concrete_problem: Residents cannot easily trace what officials claimed, what evidence was cited, and what action followed.
projects.why_now: Many public meetings are recorded but remain hard to navigate and verify.
projects.differentiator: Claim status is evidence-backed and temporal, separating statement, decision, implementation, and correction.
projects.local_first_mvp: Process a bundled synthetic meeting, agenda, and minutes and trace five claims through a vote and correction.
projects.demo_story: A quoted promise is shown as amended before the vote, preventing a misleading comparison.
projects.test_strategy: Hand-labeled fixture; alignment accuracy; provenance checks; timeline consistency.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled/open local files and optional offline ASR.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Avoid intent inference, preserve context, and require human review before publication.

projects.name: Clock-Skew Forensics
projects.one_sentence: A trace normalizer that estimates per-host clock offset and drift while preserving causal ordering uncertainty.
projects.concrete_problem: Wall-clock timestamps can make effects appear before causes across unsynchronized hosts.
projects.why_now: Edge devices and autoscaled instances often have imperfect time synchronization.
projects.differentiator: It emits interval timestamps and competing explanations instead of inventing a single corrected time.
projects.local_first_mvp: Correct a synthetic five-host incident with drifting clocks and recover the known causal chain.
projects.demo_story: An impossible negative latency becomes a bounded interval and reveals the actually slow service.
projects.test_strategy: Known-offset generators; noise sensitivity; unsatisfiable constraint cases; interval coverage.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local traces only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Preserve original timestamps and clearly label inferred corrections.

projects.name: Edge Outage Replay
projects.one_sentence: A scenario runner that replays DNS, CDN, origin, and client-cache failures as a layered edge delivery system.
projects.concrete_problem: Edge incidents emerge from interactions no single vendor dashboard can reproduce.
projects.why_now: Even small sites depend on complex caching and routing layers.
projects.differentiator: The lab separates control-plane propagation from data-plane cache state with a virtual clock.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay a certificate-expiry plus stale-cache scenario and compare purge, failover, and serve-stale mitigations.
projects.demo_story: A rushed purge worsens the outage by stampeding the origin; serve-stale contains it.
projects.test_strategy: Known cache semantics; deterministic virtual time; load conservation; scenario goldens.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic topology and traffic only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: No live traffic generation; operational recommendations remain scenario-specific.

projects.name: Geo Consistency Tuner
projects.one_sentence: A simulator that recommends per-operation consistency levels from latency budgets, staleness limits, and regional failure assumptions.
projects.concrete_problem: Global applications often choose one consistency setting despite reads and writes having different correctness needs.
projects.why_now: Multi-region deployment is accessible, but reasoning about tunable consistency remains error-prone.
projects.differentiator: It turns explicit invariants into Pareto frontiers across quorum, session, bounded-staleness, and eventual modes.
projects.local_first_mvp: Model three regions and a shopping-cart workload, then compare policies on p99 latency, lost writes, and read-your-writes violations.
projects.demo_story: The tool shows why a single strong-consistency toggle misses latency targets and proposes a safe per-operation split.
projects.test_strategy: Analytic checks on simple topologies; seeded Monte Carlo reproducibility; invariant mutation tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled synthetic latency distributions; optional public cloud latency CSV imports.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Recommendations are simulations, not deployment guarantees; assumptions remain visible in reports.

projects.name: Municipal Budget Diff
projects.one_sentence: A document-to-ledger pipeline that reconciles line-item changes across messy annual public budgets and amendments.
projects.concrete_problem: Budget PDFs change labels and hierarchy, making year-over-year comparisons misleading.
projects.why_now: Public scrutiny depends on accessible, reproducible fiscal comparisons.
projects.differentiator: Entity matches carry evidence and accounting reconciliation; uncertain mappings remain unresolved instead of guessed.
projects.local_first_mvp: Process two bundled synthetic budget PDFs with reorganized departments and produce a balanced change report.
projects.demo_story: An apparent cut is revealed as a departmental transfer with exact page evidence.
projects.test_strategy: Known layout fixtures; accounting identities; mapping precision; extraction round trips.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled/open public documents; offline OCR optional.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Uncertain matches are labeled and reports should not imply motive.

projects.name: Reserve Stress Engine
projects.one_sentence: A balance-sheet simulator for testing redemption, duration, liquidity, and counterparty shocks against token or fund reserves.
projects.concrete_problem: Headline reserve ratios hide maturity mismatch and correlated liquidation losses.
projects.why_now: Tokenized cash and stable-value products make reserve quality a public concern.
projects.differentiator: Scenario results reconcile every cash flow and expose assumptions rather than outputting a single risk score.
projects.local_first_mvp: Stress a synthetic reserve portfolio under a 30-percent redemption wave and compare two liquidation policies.
projects.demo_story: A fully backed portfolio becomes temporarily illiquid because long-duration assets cannot be sold without loss.
projects.test_strategy: Balance conservation; closed-form cases; scenario determinism; sensitivity analysis.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic/open balance sheets; no price API required.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Educational risk analysis, not a solvency rating or investment advice.

projects.name: Stream Dedup Index
projects.one_sentence: A bounded-state engine for exact and near-duplicate detection across late, reordered event streams.
projects.concrete_problem: Retries and reordered producers create duplicate events after naive time-window caches expire.
projects.why_now: At-least-once delivery is common and global identifiers remain unreliable.
projects.differentiator: It exposes the explicit precision, memory, lateness, and retention tradeoff for each strategy.
projects.local_first_mvp: Process a million generated events with retries and mutations, meeting a memory cap while reporting false merges.
projects.demo_story: A duplicate arriving hours late is caught without retaining every payload.
projects.test_strategy: Ground-truth generators; adversarial collisions; memory assertions; restart equivalence.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Generated event streams only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Similarity merges are reviewable and never silently delete source events.

projects.name: Tax Lot Optimizer
projects.one_sentence: A local optimization engine that selects asset lots under gains, wash-sale-like constraints, transaction costs, and portfolio drift.
projects.concrete_problem: Choosing lots manually is combinatorial and can create future constraints invisible in a greedy sale.
projects.why_now: Fractional lots and frequent transactions increase record complexity.
projects.differentiator: It provides an auditable solver certificate and compares greedy, exact, and robust policies on synthetic cases.
projects.local_first_mvp: Optimize a synthetic sale across 200 lots and verify realized gains and constraint satisfaction against brute force on small cases.
projects.demo_story: The lowest-gain greedy choice is rejected because it creates a costlier future constraint.
projects.test_strategy: Ledger invariants; exhaustive small instances; solver feasibility certificates; boundary-date tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic/manual CSV only; no brokerage API.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Educational optimizer, not tax advice; rules are configurable and not asserted current.

projects.name: Adaptive Shard Rebalancer
projects.one_sentence: A consistent-hash cluster simulator that plans bounded-movement shard reassignments under hotspots and node churn.
projects.concrete_problem: Naive consistent hashing balances key counts, not load, and can overload replicas during rebalancing.
projects.why_now: Skewed tenant workloads make static shard layouts increasingly wasteful.
projects.differentiator: It jointly optimizes movement cost, replica diversity, hotspot relief, and temporary transfer bandwidth.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay a Zipfian workload on six simulated nodes and produce a staged plan that cuts peak utilization without violating two-replica safety.
projects.demo_story: The user removes a node and sees a plan outperform simple ring redistribution on bytes moved and peak load.
projects.test_strategy: Golden topology cases; property tests for replica constraints; optimizer bounds; fault injection during transfers.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic workload traces are built in; optional metrics imports are local files.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Generated plans are advisory and require dry-run validation before touching real data.

projects.name: Binary Size Atlas
projects.one_sentence: A compiler-artifact analyzer that attributes binary growth to source features, generics, dependencies, and linker decisions.
projects.concrete_problem: Size regressions are discovered late and symbol lists rarely explain why code was retained or duplicated.
projects.why_now: Edge deployment and WebAssembly renew pressure on compact artifacts.
projects.differentiator: It builds a retention graph from source symbols to final sections and compares two builds causally.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compare two Rust or C builds and trace a 40KB increase to one generic instantiation chain.
projects.demo_story: A dependency bump is innocent; one new formatting call retained an unexpected subsystem.
projects.test_strategy: Tiny controlled binaries; parser fuzzing; byte-total conservation; compiler-version fixtures.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Local compiler outputs only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Recommendations preserve correctness and are presented with uncertainty around optimized code.

projects.name: Credit Fairness Simulator
projects.one_sentence: A lending-policy simulator that measures calibration, access, default, profit, and fairness across shifting populations.
projects.concrete_problem: A fairness metric can improve while long-term access or error burden worsens.
projects.why_now: Automated credit decisions face increasing scrutiny and distribution shift.
projects.differentiator: It models sequential outcomes and policy feedback rather than auditing a static classifier alone.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compare three threshold policies over five simulated years and expose a fairness reversal under population drift.
projects.demo_story: A policy fair at launch creates unequal future data, then fails its own metric two years later.
projects.test_strategy: Known metric cases; causal sensitivity; seeded populations; invariance tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic data only; optional open aggregate statistics.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Not for real eligibility decisions; protected-attribute and causal assumptions must be explicit.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Deadlock Detector
projects.one_sentence: A runtime analyzer that detects circular waits, contradictory goals, and livelock in collaborating tool-using agents.
projects.concrete_problem: Agent teams can wait on each other, duplicate work, or exchange messages forever without an observable lock primitive.
projects.why_now: Delegated agent workflows are moving from demos to long-running automation.
projects.differentiator: It infers a wait-for graph from tasks, messages, resources, and promised artifacts, then proposes the smallest safe break.
projects.local_first_mvp: Run three scripted agents into a resource cycle and a polite-message livelock, detecting and replaying both.
projects.demo_story: The system explains that no agent is idle, yet none can complete because each promises an artifact owned by another.
projects.test_strategy: Known wait graphs; randomized traces; false-positive progress cases; detector latency tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Scripted local agents and synthetic event traces only.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Automatic cancellation is disabled by default because inferred dependencies can be wrong.

projects.name: Urban Canopy Cooling Model
projects.one_sentence: A neighborhood-scale model that estimates shade access and heat exposure changes from tree placement over time.
projects.concrete_problem: Canopy percentages ignore where shade falls, when it is useful, and who can access it.
projects.why_now: Extreme heat makes pedestrian-scale shade a critical local infrastructure service.
projects.differentiator: It optimizes staged planting for time-of-day pedestrian exposure and maintenance survival, not just mature canopy area.
projects.local_first_mvp: Model a synthetic neighborhood, place 50 trees, and compare canopy-maximizing versus heat-exposure-minimizing plans.
projects.demo_story: The highest-canopy plan loses because its shade misses afternoon walking routes for a decade.
projects.test_strategy: Geometric shadow cases; optimizer feasibility; sensitivity to growth; deterministic scenarios.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic map plus optional open GIS/weather files.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Planning screen only; planting requires utilities, ecology, ownership, and accessibility review.

projects.name: Byzantine Quorum Workbench
projects.one_sentence: An interactive simulator for quorum intersection, equivocation, view changes, and signature costs in Byzantine consensus.
projects.concrete_problem: Students can recite 3f+1 but struggle to connect quorum math to concrete malicious message schedules.
projects.why_now: BFT ideas now appear in ledgers, replicated databases, and cross-organization infrastructure.
projects.differentiator: It searches for adversarial schedules and renders the exact quorum intersection that preserves or violates safety.
projects.local_first_mvp: Simulate four replicas with one equivocator across normal and view-change rounds, then find and visualize all minimal stalled schedules.
projects.demo_story: Changing one quorum size immediately produces an adversarial double-commit trace and highlights the disjoint votes.
projects.test_strategy: Exhaust small state spaces; differential-test known protocol invariants; mutation-test quorum rules.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Pure simulation with local cryptographic libraries and generated keys.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Generated attacks target toy protocols and should not claim vulnerabilities in production implementations.

projects.name: Liquidity Contagion Network
projects.one_sentence: A network stress model for margin calls, collateral haircuts, fire sales, and payment-gridlock contagion.
projects.concrete_problem: Institution-by-institution risk views miss feedback loops transmitted through shared assets and obligations.
projects.why_now: Financial and crypto markets share increasingly rapid collateral feedback mechanisms.
projects.differentiator: Each failure cascade is decomposed into obligation, price-impact, and liquidity channels.
projects.local_first_mvp: Simulate 50 synthetic institutions and identify the smallest shock triggering a cascade.
projects.demo_story: A small asset shock spreads through collateral reuse, not direct credit exposure.
projects.test_strategy: Closed-form networks; balance conservation; solver convergence tests; seeded stress sweeps.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic networks and optional open aggregates.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Do not identify real firms or present synthetic stress as a forecast.

projects.name: Options Microstructure Sandbox
projects.one_sentence: A discrete-event options exchange simulator modeling spreads, Greeks, queue priority, hedging, and volatility shocks.
projects.concrete_problem: Textbook option prices omit how execution and hedging costs behave in an order book.
projects.why_now: Accessible options trading has outpaced understanding of liquidity risk.
projects.differentiator: It links theoretical valuation to fill-level P&L attribution under synthetic market mechanics.
projects.local_first_mvp: Simulate one option chain through a volatility jump and attribute market-maker loss to spread, inventory, and hedge slippage.
projects.demo_story: A theoretically fair quote loses money because queue position and hedge latency dominate.
projects.test_strategy: Put-call/parity checks; order-book invariants; seeded scenarios; analytic limiting cases.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic prices only; no broker or market feed.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: No live-trading integration or personalized strategy claims.

projects.name: Differential Query Sandbox
projects.one_sentence: A local SQL sandbox that compares raw and differentially private query results while measuring reconstruction risk.
projects.concrete_problem: Privacy mechanisms are taught as formulas without showing how query shape, clipping, and repetition affect actual leakage.
projects.why_now: Organizations publish increasingly granular aggregates from sensitive datasets.
projects.differentiator: It pairs every noisy answer with an adversarial reconstruction experiment and uncertainty calibration.
projects.local_first_mvp: Load a synthetic health table, issue counts under a budget, and show reconstruction accuracy rising when protections are intentionally disabled.
projects.demo_story: Two queries with the same epsilon produce very different utility and attack outcomes because their bounds differ.
projects.test_strategy: Monte Carlo coverage tests; known sensitivity cases; attack baseline comparisons; deterministic seeded runs.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Bundled synthetic datasets only; local SQL engine.
projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Prevents importing real sensitive records by default and labels all examples as educational.

projects.name: Dwell Typing Laboratory
projects.one_sentence: An adaptive on-screen keyboard simulator optimizing dwell thresholds, target layout, and error correction for motor access.
projects.concrete_problem: Fixed dwell settings force a poor tradeoff between accidental activation and exhausting delay.
projects.why_now: Eye and head pointing are increasingly available through consumer hardware.
projects.differentiator: A trace-driven optimizer reports throughput, error, fatigue proxies, and robustness rather than one speed metric.
projects.local_first_mvp: Replay open/synthetic pointer traces and compare fixed versus adaptive dwell on phrase entry.
projects.demo_story: Adaptive dwell cuts false keys without slowing deliberate selections.
projects.test_strategy: Ground-truth trace corpus; state-machine properties; throughput/error confidence; accessibility review.

projects.name: Peer Review Consistency Auditor
projects.one_sentence: A private rubric engine that flags unexplained scoring inconsistencies across anonymized submissions without ranking reviewers.

projects.name: QUIC Congestion Simulator
projects.one_sentence: A packet-level simulator comparing congestion-control behavior under loss, reordering, migration, and changing paths.

projects.name: Sensory Environment Mapper

projects.data_and_api_constraints: Synthetic CSV or user-owned local sensor exports.

projects.name: Learned Index Benchlab
projects.one_sentence: A reproducible laboratory comparing learned indexes with B-trees under drift, skew, updates, and memory limits.

projects.name: Phishing Behavior Range
projects.one_sentence: A closed local cyber range that models deceptive login flows and scores defenses from browser signals and user-visible cues.
projects.concrete_problem: Static phishing screenshots do not teach how redirects, lookalike origins, autofill, and MFA prompts interact.

projects.name: Incremental Query Compiler
projects.one_sentence: A compiler kernel that memoizes semantic queries, tracks fine-grained dependencies, and invalidates only facts affected by an edit.
projects.concrete_problem: Whole-module recompilation makes interactive tooling slow, while ad hoc caches silently return stale types and diagnostics.

projects.misuse_or_safety_notes: Cache evidence must never be represented as a proof of source correctness. Risk: Unsound reuse caused by missed dependencies or unstable identities. Non-goal: a production optimizing compiler or language package manager.

projects.name: Effect Capability Checker

projects.name: Verified Bytecode Optimizer

projects.name: Grammar Repair Parser

projects.name: Profile-Guided WebAssembly Specializer

projects.test_strategy: Differential execution; official-style validation fixtures; adversarial profile shifts; size-budget and determinism checks.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Data plan: Bundled WASM modules and synthetic traces. Dependency policy: use standard-library or permissively licensed, lockfile-pinned packages; the runtime must work offline; no paid APIs or credentials.

projects.name: Refactoring Proof Engine
projects.one_sentence: A source-to-source refactoring engine that proves binding and control-flow obligations before applying a patch.
projects.concrete_problem: Textual refactors can capture names, alter evaluation order, or cross exception boundaries while still compiling.

projects.test_strategy: Metamorphic refactor tests; interpreter trace equivalence; adversarial shadowing corpus; obligation mutation tests.

projects.name: Macro Expansion Debugger
projects.one_sentence: A hygienic macro tracer that reconstructs expansion phases, scope marks, and source origins as a reversible execution history.
projects.concrete_problem: Macro errors surface in generated code far from the invocation and hide which phase introduced a captured or malformed identifier.
projects.why_now: Language tooling is moving into editors, build systems, and sandboxes where incremental correctness and explainability matter as much as peak throughput.
projects.differentiator: A provenance DAG supports step-back expansion and scope-identity queries without flattening generated syntax to text.
projects.local_first_mvp: Expand a bundled DSL, step backward from an unbound identifier, and identify the exact transformer that dropped its scope mark. Milestones: 1) model hygienic syntax; 2) record expansion events; 3) build reverse traversal; 4) ship failing macro fixture.
projects.demo_story: Selecting a generated identifier reveals its three ancestors and the phase where binding identity diverged.
projects.test_strategy: Golden expansion traces; alpha-renaming properties; cyclic-expansion limits; provenance round-trip checks.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Data plan: Bundled macros and generated syntax objects. Dependency policy: use standard-library or permissively licensed, lockfile-pinned packages; the runtime must work offline; no paid APIs or credentials.

projects.name: Memory Layout ABI Auditor
projects.one_sentence: A cross-language layout engine that computes records, padding, calling conventions, and binary-compatibility witnesses from declarative ABIs.
projects.concrete_problem: Foreign-function interfaces fail subtly when compilers disagree about alignment, bitfields, enum width, or aggregate passing.
projects.why_now: Language tooling is moving into editors, build systems, and sandboxes where incremental correctness and explainability matter as much as peak throughput.
projects.differentiator: Symbolic layout constraints produce byte-level witnesses and smallest-breaking-change explanations across ABI versions.
projects.local_first_mvp: Compare bundled C and Rust-like declarations for two target ABIs and expose a one-byte padding change that breaks a call boundary. Milestones: 1) encode scalar rules; 2) solve aggregate layouts; 3) model function passing; 4) diff ABI fixture versions.
projects.demo_story: A harmless-looking field reorder changes register classification, and the auditor renders the exact affected bytes.
projects.test_strategy: Compiler-layout golden files; randomized structure generation; DWARF cross-checks; endianness and packing fixtures.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Data plan: Bundled ABI specifications and synthetic debug metadata. Dependency policy: use standard-library or permissively licensed, lockfile-pinned packages; the runtime must work offline; no paid APIs or credentials.

projects.name: Deterministic Language Server Core
projects.one_sentence: A scheduler and snapshot engine that makes asynchronous language-server results reproducible under rapid edits and cancellation.
projects.concrete_problem: Language servers race document versions, background indexing, and cancellation, causing ghost diagnostics and irreproducible bugs.

projects.name: Binary Lifting Analysis Lab
projects.one_sentence: A defensive binary-analysis workbench that lifts a small executable format into typed SSA and validates control-flow recovery against an emulator.

projects.name: Userspace Kernel Sandbox
projects.one_sentence: A deterministic userspace kernel that runs untrusted processes against virtual files, clocks, sockets, and resource quotas.

projects.one_sentence: A record/replay runtime that captures nondeterministic system-call results and schedules to reproduce native process failures offline.

projects.name: Scheduler Tail-Latency Lab
projects.one_sentence: A discrete-event CPU scheduler laboratory that explains tail latency under priorities, affinity, preemption, and mixed workloads.

projects.name: Page Cache Policy Lab

projects.name: Priority Inversion Explorer

projects.name: Texture Streaming Simulator

projects.name: Scene Difference Renderer
projects.one_sentence: A semantic renderer that attributes pixel differences between scene revisions to geometry, material, lighting, and sampling changes.

projects.why_now: Modern media pipelines need transparent quality, color, timing, and memory tradeoffs that can be explored locally with generated assets.

projects.name: Offline Map-Matching Engine
projects.one_sentence: A probabilistic map matcher that aligns noisy, sparse GPS traces to a local road graph with uncertainty and alternate paths.

projects.why_now: Offline geospatial computation is valuable for field work, resilience, and privacy, and it offers deep problems in topology, indexing, uncertainty, and routing.

projects.demo_story: The engine avoids snapping across a divided highway and delays commitment through a 45-second GPS gap.
projects.test_strategy: Synthetic ground truth; noise/dropout sweeps; graph-disconnection fixtures; posterior calibration and determinism tests.
projects.data_and_api_constraints: Data plan: Generated road networks plus optionally downloaded open extracts prepared in advance. Dependency policy: use standard-library or permissively licensed, lockfile-pinned packages; the runtime must work offline; no paid APIs or credentials.
